purpose: Carry the current family-specific weapon-penetration state into mixed-TL integration without converting the shared CP86 sensitivity axes into a universal progression ladder.

Energy.note: Future Energy progression may use another family-appropriate property rather than penetration growth.

Missile.note: Future Missile progression may instead advance guidance, seekers, propulsion, payload, salvo behavior, or another missile-specific property.

crossTlUse.kinetic: Use SPEN1/APEN1 for the locally validated TL2 Kinetic working package; retain SPEN1/APEN0 as TL1/current older-technology reference.
crossTlUse.energy: Use current SPEN1/APEN1 until a family-appropriate later candidate is separately justified.
crossTlUse.missile: Use current SPEN1/APEN2 until a family-appropriate later candidate is separately justified.
